# Keep edited entries in place after draft recovery

## What & Why
Recovering an edit should update the existing saved entry rather than changing its position or creating a duplicate, especially when a list contains multiple saved entries.

## Done looks like
- Recovering an edited answer updates the original card in its existing list position.
- Recovering an edited opportunity updates the original row in its existing list position.
- Reloading preserves the same order with no duplicate entries.
